teams.heading: Fiji Rugby confirm interest in recruiting Mark Nawaqanitawase for the World Cup
teams.body: Fiji Rugby have confirmed interest in recruiting Mark Nawaqanitawase for the World Cup, a report first run about a week ago. It lands as Jake White, named head coach on Tuesday from 31 applicants, takes charge of a side ranked 10th in the world. Fiji are in Pool C at the 2027 World Cup in Australia with Argentina, Canada and Spain.

lead.why: It is the Fiji-side recruitment story with the most concrete event, and the Jake White appointment has already been reported.

teams.heading: England women end 41-match unbeaten run as Canada win 24-21 in Toronto
teams.body: England women were beaten 24-21 by Canada in Toronto on Friday, a first defeat since 2022 that ends a 41-match unbeaten run. Canada had drawn 26-26 with England at Sandy Park in September, and their semi-final dismantling of New Zealand at last year's World Cup showed how far they have closed the gap on the world champions. Sale hooker Amy Cokayne, who has 95 caps, faced the press this week: "You can't dwell on it." The teams meet three times this autumn in the WXV Global Series.

lead.why: It is the only new England item of substance, and it is a result that ends a long unbeaten run; the men's Champions Cup pieces repeat stories already run this week.

teams.heading: Thomas Ramos ruled out of France's autumn Nations Championship with thigh setback
teams.body: According to L'Equipe, Thomas Ramos will miss all four of France's autumn matches after aggravating a thigh injury first picked up in September. Les Bleus have chosen to rest him for the rest of the autumn rather than risk a longer problem. The loss of their main goal-kicker, who kicked the winning penalty against England in the 2026 Six Nations, lands with Jalibert, Meafou and Marchand already on the injury list. Galthié is expected to name his 42-man squad on Wednesday.

lead.why: A fresh men's national-squad injury blow to France's first-choice fullback and main goal-kicker, reported yesterday, outranks the club results.

teams.heading: Farrell set to name Ireland squad with Caelan Doris still sidelined
teams.body: Andy Farrell is set to name his Ireland squad for the second Nations Championship window, with Caelan Doris still sidelined and some welcome returnees expected, according to The42. Ireland host Argentina in Dublin before facing Fiji and then the Springboks, and Farrell will be demanding more accuracy and energy after what The42 called an error-strewn defeat to New Zealand in Auckland in July.

lead.why: It is the only NEW item about the men's national squad, and the squad announcement is the story Irish fans are waiting on today.

teams.heading: Italy lost 32-14 to South Africa at home in November 2025
teams.body: Italy lost 32-14 to South Africa at home in November 2025, in an international friendly. Next they meet South Africa in Round 4 of the Nations Championship. So far in the competition, Italy have played three matches, won none and lost three. Their points tally is 37 scored and 131 conceded. Italy's points difference over those matches is -94.

teams.heading: Stuart Hogg stripped of MBE over domestic abuse conviction this year
teams.body: Former Scotland captain Stuart Hogg has lost his MBE after pleading guilty to a domestic abuse charge involving his estranged wife. The honour, awarded in the 2024 New Year Honours for services to rugby, was removed in March and the decision confirmed that month. Hogg won 100 caps for Scotland and toured three times with the British & Irish Lions. The Cabinet Office's register lists him among 15 people whose honours have been revoked in 2026.

lead.why: It is the only new-to-the-tab men's Scotland story in the shortlist that is not the Ritchie debut already run this week.

teams.heading: Steve Tandy leaves door open for Taulupe Faletau's 2027 World Cup bid
teams.body: Taulupe Faletau, 35, has been left out of Steve Tandy's 39-man squad for the Nations Championship, despite returning from injury for Cardiff against Northampton on Sunday. Tandy has not ruled the Wales great out of the 2027 World Cup in Australia, saying he can "see the drive in him" and that Faletau must first put consistent rugby together. The 109-cap number eight has not played under Tandy and has played at three World Cups, missing 2019 with a collarbone injury.

lead.why: It is the strongest new item on the shortlist, covered by two outlets, and it concerns a senior player's omission from the national squad.

teams.heading: Harry Wilson, Fraser McReight back Wallabies' UK tour after Bledisloe loss
teams.body: Skipper Harry Wilson and flanker Fraser McReight are confident the Wallabies can bounce back on tour, with the opener at Twickenham against England followed by Scotland and Wales. Wilson said he "probably never felt under so much pressure" as in the last two games against the All Blacks, the 43-21 Sydney loss and the 50-19 Eden Park defeat before it. McReight, who has fond memories of Twickenham's 2024 win over England, says the All Blacks are "world-class for a reason."

lead.why: The only shortlist item with a new angle: the skipper and flanker looking ahead to the UK tour, rather than another retelling of the Bledisloe loss or the Matfield quote already run.

teams.heading: Japan men's sevens beat Hong Kong China 28-14 in Colombo final
teams.body: In sevens, Japan's men beat Hong Kong China 28-14 in the final of Asia Rugby Emirates Sevens Series leg two in Colombo, a rare defeat for the defending series champions. The sides meet often, but Japan were deserved winners this time. The women's Sakura Sevens also took the leg, beating China 14-7 to claim the series, and they now turn their attention to HSBC SVNS, which starts in Dubai at the end of November.

lead.why: The Kwagga Smith story was already run on Tuesday, so the strongest new item is Japan's sevens double in Colombo, labelled as sevens.

teams.heading: All Blacks went out early to honour Nathan Charles ahead of Sydney Test
teams.body: The All Blacks went out early for Saturday's second Bledisloe Cup Test at Accor Stadium so they could go over to former Wallabies hooker Nathan Charles, who has revealed his Motor Neurone Disease diagnosis. The whole team went to him on the field, and captain Codie Taylor later presented him with a framed All Blacks jersey signed by the squad. Ex-All Blacks scrum-half Justin Marshall called the gesture "incredible" on a podcast.

lead.why: It is a new item about the All Blacks themselves, and the gesture to Nathan Charles is the story a fan would pass on.

teams.heading: Springbok Dan du Preez sidelined by hamstring tear, missing Bath's next two
teams.body: At club level, Springbok forward Dan du Preez is out for Bath's next two Premiership matches after tearing a hamstring in training before their Investec Champions Cup defeat to Montpellier. The 31-year-old, who joined from Sale Sharks this season, has made two appearances for Bath and scored two tries, and head of rugby Johann van Graan says the injury will rule him out for a considerable time. For South Africa, it is a fresh back-row worry as the November window approaches.

lead.why: It is a fresh injury to a Springbok forward, the most concrete new event on the shortlist, and it is the only NEW item here that is about a player's availability.
